verdict.rationale: Canny's own docs say that once users are identified through its JavaScript SDK, the feedback they leave is tied to their existing user account in your application, so each feedback item is linked to the customer who submitted it. The MCP docs also describe asking what customers asked for and the context behind each request. Missing for 10: documentation of a PM manually attributing feedback to a customer (e.g., on their behalf), evidence that Autopilot-captured feedback from Gong/Intercom/Slack is attributed to specific customers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can link individual feedback items to the specific customers who submitted them

citations.quote: Install our JavaScript SDK to identify your users. This way, when they leave feedback on Canny, it'll be tied to their existing user account in your application.
Ask your LLM what customers asked for and understand the context behind each request.
